entries.text: Alder Instruments registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the sourcing classification of each item to that item's registered product record.
Alder Bench Multimeter: a four-and-a-half digit bench meter with shrouded terminals. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor a sourcing classification.

Registered product terms. Intended use: field calibration work on service benches. Sourcing classification: the responsible-sourcing audit for this meter has not been filed, so no registered classification exists for the restricted material question.
